findings.now: Changing the month, or the Item 1 year, and pressing Save draft moves the return to another period's row, and if that period already holds a draft its content is overwritten.
findings.why: The draft is keyed by TIN, form, year and month (form_2000.rs:1404-1408), upsert_from_draft updates whichever row matches (db/queueable.rs:154-168), and the dashboard tile keeps reopening the original period.

options.name: Lock the period
options.detail: Disable the month buttons and the year input once a draft exists, because the tile defines the period.

options.name: Explicit move
options.detail: Make a period change a 'move return' action that refuses to overwrite a non-empty draft.

options.name: Refuse on save
options.detail: Block Save when the edited period differs from the period the draft was opened for.

findings.now: Schedules 1 to 4 each show three fixed rows with no add control, so a fourth ATC line, payment or remittance cannot be entered.
findings.why: The official schedules grow ('Add' appends rows, per form_2000.rs:31-33) and the model allows 50 rows (form_2000.rs:35, 1209), so the extra lines are silently left out.

options.name: Add row button
options.detail: Append rows on demand and splice them after the last row, as official_layout already does.

options.name: Scrollable table
options.detail: Show up to the model limit of 50 rows in a scrollable table with a count.

options.name: Warn when full
options.detail: Show a notice when a schedule is full and the filer must add the rest by hand.

findings.now: TIN and RDO are read-only text on this page, yet the alerts say 'Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 4.' and 'Please enter a valid RDO Code on Item 5.'
findings.why: The draft copies the profile values at creation (form_2000.rs:582-583) and load_draft never refreshes them (queueable_forms.rs:43-47), so a bad value blocks Queue with no fix on this page.

options.name: Editable identifiers
options.detail: Let the filer correct the TIN and RDO on the draft, under the profile's own rules.

options.name: Refresh from profile
options.detail: Re-read the profile values when an editable draft opens.

options.name: Link to profile
options.detail: Replace the alerts with a button that opens the taxpayer profile.

findings.now: Each Schedule 1 row opens a wrapped list of 25 outline buttons with full ATC descriptions and no search, which the filer scans for each of the three rows.
findings.why: The official form takes several ATCs, so a searchable multi-select combobox would replace the wall of buttons.

options.name: Multi-select combobox
options.detail: Searchable list showing code, description and rate, one selection per Schedule 1 row.

options.name: Chips plus combobox
options.detail: Show the chosen ATCs as chips with a combobox beside them to add more.

options.name: Grouped select
options.detail: Group the 25 options by DS family in a single select.

findings.now: Twelve month buttons (Jan to Dec) wrap across the Return period section.
findings.why: Twelve options exceed the four-option button limit in the audit rule, so a combobox fits better.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A single month combobox showing the current month.

options.name: Native select
options.detail: A plain select with twelve months, the least code.

options.name: Quarter then month
options.detail: Pick the quarter first, then the month, if the filer prefers fewer choices on screen.

findings.now: Errors for the year, name, address, zip, phone, other party and TIN leave their labels black, so the filer finds them only in the list.
findings.why: field() (form_2000_view.rs:495-499) compares error keys such as taxpayer_name, registered_address and zip_code with the input keys name, address and zip.

options.name: Map keys to inputs
options.detail: Report each error under its editor key so the comparison matches.

options.name: Message beside field
options.detail: Render each message under its own input as well as in the list.

options.name: Focus first error
options.detail: Scroll to and focus the first failing input when Queue is pressed.

findings.now: The Needs review list stops at 20 messages with no 'and N more' line, while Queue stays disabled.
findings.why: A return with many schedule date errors can show only part of the problem, so the filer cannot see what still blocks Queue.

options.name: Show all messages
options.detail: Remove the 20-line cap, as the shared kit does at 30 with a scroll area.

options.name: Count line
options.detail: Keep the cap and add an 'and N more' line.

options.name: Group by section
options.detail: Group messages under their schedule so the list is shorter.

findings.now: Commit 0c3641af, titled as a 2000 fix, also changes crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_2000ot.rs (about 88 lines) and tools/official-xml/official.js.
findings.why: Outside the form's own files only one-line registrations may change, and this edit alters the 2000OT model.

options.name: Split the commit
options.detail: Move the 2000OT changes into their own commit with their own tests.

options.name: Revert the 2000OT lines
options.detail: Restore form_2000ot.rs if the 2000 fix does not need them.

options.name: Keep with a note
options.detail: Keep the change and record it as an accepted shared fix in the review notes.
